nodes.label: Theme selection: pastel / calm / night
nodes.rationale: Pick look by script mood: pastel everyday, calm trust topics (tax/debt), night drama (scams, myths); never mix in one video.

nodes.label: Chapters = rupee-note colour fields (₹10→₹20→₹50→₹500, ₹2000 for twists)
nodes.rationale: Escalation by denomination; field change rides the chapter cut.
nodes.norm_label: chapters = rupee-note colour fields (₹10→₹20→₹50→₹500, ₹2000 for twists)

nodes.label: Motivated transitions (hard cut default; whip/zoom/wipe/page budgeted)
nodes.rationale: Cuts must read like a real editor, never title cards.
nodes.norm_label: motivated transitions (hard cut default; whip/zoom/wipe/page budgeted)

nodes.label: No on-screen structure labels rule
nodes.rationale: Chapter names / setup / payoff on screen are AI-look tells; validator blocks them.

nodes.label: Show, don't caption
nodes.rationale: Caption band already carries the words; frame must add an object/number/reaction.

nodes.label: Editor passes: rhythm, cut points, comedic timing, transitions, sound, overlays
nodes.rationale: Vary shot lengths (equal shots feel machine-made); hold punchline until word ends then cut to reaction.
nodes.norm_label: editor passes: rhythm, cut points, comedic timing, transitions, sound, overlays

nodes.label: Script review rubric (stop power, laughs, specificity, clarity, escalation, payoff, speakability, facts)
nodes.rationale: 3 = fine = not good enough; PASS only if facts pass, laughs ≥ minimum and every score ≥ 4.
nodes.norm_label: script review rubric (stop power, laughs, specificity, clarity, escalation, payoff, speakability, facts)

nodes.label: Reel format table (30/60/90 s: words, chapters, laughs, re-hook cadence)
nodes.rationale: ≈2.7 spoken words/s at Chillar pace.
nodes.norm_label: reel format table (30/60/90 s: words, chapters, laughs, re-hook cadence)

nodes.label: Joke craft (specificity, self-roast, rule of three, deadpan tag, callbacks)
nodes.rationale: Facts are the spine; jokes are how facts get remembered. Take Tanmay Bhat / Vishal Dayama craft, never material.
nodes.norm_label: joke craft (specificity, self-roast, rule of three, deadpan tag, callbacks)

nodes.label: AI-look tells checklist
nodes.rationale: Structure labels, centred everything, repeated components, title-card transitions => REVISE.

nodes.label: Fact-check status table (✅ / ⚠ / ❌)
nodes.rationale: Anything not ✅ blocks /render; prefer primary sources and check for newer circulars.

nodes.label: Cover package scoring (curiosity, clarity, honesty ≥4)
nodes.rationale: Honesty < 4 disqualified: payoff must deliver exactly the cover.
